# HTTP router comparison

Machine: GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-24.04` runner, 4 vCPUs. Not a dedicated
benchmark host, so treat this as a reproducible lower bound, not a peak number;
rerun `tests/en/apps/httpbench/bench/run.sh` on quieter hardware for the full spread.

Raw per-request data: [`results-2026-10-31.jsonl`](./results-2026-10-31.jsonl).

<!-- generated by bench/report.salam from /tmp/httpbench/results.json -->

Load: 64 connections, 2 generator threads, 10s measured per route.
